note: skill_tree.yml as SkillTreeDatabase loads it, by job ID, with the skills of the jobs in Inherit added as loadingFinished adds them (not the excluded ones, and not the ones the job lists itself), and skills with a MaxLevel of 0 removed. max_level and the levels in requires are capped at the skill's MaxLevel. requires lists [skill ID, level] in file order.
